## Classes

### <a name="influxdb"></a>`influxdb`

Installs InfluxDB OSS 1.x from InfluxData's package repository, writes
`influxdb.conf` from `configuration` merged over the module's defaults,
starts the service and then creates the admin user, databases, users and
retention policies through the `influx` CLI.

Authentication is on by default (`http.auth-enabled`). On a new server
InfluxDB lets the first admin user be created without logging in, which is
how `admin_username` gets created. If users already exist and they don't
include `admin_username` with `admin_password`, the run fails with a message
instead of switching authentication off to reset it.

#### Examples

##### A server with a database and two users

```puppet
class { 'influxdb':
  admin_username => 'admin',
  admin_password => Sensitive('change-me'),
  databases      => {
    'telegraf' => {},
  },
  users          => {
    'telegraf' => {
      'password'  => Sensitive('telegraf-password'),
      'privilege' => 'WRITE',
      'database'  => 'telegraf',
    },
    'grafana'  => {
      'password'  => Sensitive('grafana-password'),
      'privilege' => 'READ',
      'database'  => 'telegraf',
    },
  },
  retention_policies => {
    'one_year' => {
      'database' => 'telegraf',
      'duration' => '52w',
    },
  },
}
```

##### Changing settings in influxdb.conf

```puppet
class { 'influxdb':
  admin_username => 'admin',
  admin_password => Sensitive('change-me'),
  configuration  => {
    'data' => {
      'dir'                     => '/srv/influxdb/data',
      'wal-dir'                 => '/srv/influxdb/wal',
      'max-series-per-database' => 0,
    },
  },
}
```

##### <a name="-influxdb--admin_username"></a>`admin_username`

Data type: `String[1]`

##### <a name="-influxdb--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

`absent` stops InfluxDB and removes the package, configuration file and
(if managed) the repository. The data directories are left in place.

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-influxdb--ensure_package"></a>`ensure_package`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

The package's `ensure`, such as a version. Defaults to `ensure`.

Default value: `undef`

Data type: `String[1]`

The package that provides `influxd` and `influx`.

Default value: `'influxdb'`

##### <a name="-influxdb--manage_repo"></a>`manage_repo`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to add InfluxData's repository. Set to false when the repository
is managed elsewhere.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-influxdb--repo_location"></a>`repo_location`

Data type: `String[1]`

The repository URL: the APT location on Debian and Ubuntu, the YUM base
URL on Red Hat and its rebuilds.

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

APT only: the release (suite) in `repo_location`.

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

APT only: the signing key's file name in `/etc/apt/keyrings`. The `.asc`
extension tells APT the key is ASCII-armored.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-influxdb--repo_key_source"></a>`repo_key_source`

Data type: `Stdlib::HTTPUrl`

##### <a name="-influxdb--configuration"></a>`configuration`

Data type: `Hash`

Settings for `influxdb.conf`, merged over the module's defaults (yours
win). Top-level keys are the file's sections, such as `data` and `http`;
`bind-address` and `reporting-disabled` go at the top level, and `udp`,
`graphite`, `collectd` and `opentsdb` take an array of hashes.

Default value: `{}`

Data type: `Stdlib::Port`

The HTTP API port: used in the default `http.bind-address`, and by Puppet

Default value: `8086`

Default value: `'/etc/influxdb/influxdb.conf'`

### <a name="influxdb--retention_policy"></a>`influxdb::retention_policy`

Durations are InfluxQL duration literals, such as `52w`, `365d` or
`8760h0m0s`, or `INF` to keep data forever. Equal durations written
differently (`52w` and `8736h0m0s`) count as the same.

#### Examples

##### Keep a year of data, as the database's default policy

```puppet
influxdb::retention_policy { 'one_year':
  database => 'telegraf',
  duration => '52w',
}
```

The following parameters are available in the `influxdb::retention_policy` defined type:

* [`replicas`](#-influxdb--retention_policy--replicas)
* [`is_default`](#-influxdb--retention_policy--is_default)
* [`admin_username`](#-influxdb--retention_policy--admin_username)

##### <a name="-influxdb--retention_policy--database"></a>`database`

Data type: `String[1]`

##### <a name="-influxdb--retention_policy--duration"></a>`duration`

Data type: `String[1]`

How long to keep data.

##### <a name="-influxdb--retention_policy--shard_duration"></a>`shard_duration`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

The time range each shard covers. Leave undef to let InfluxDB pick it from

##### <a name="-influxdb--retention_policy--replicas"></a>`replicas`

Data type: `Integer[1]`

The replication factor. Open-source InfluxDB runs one node, so this is 1.

##### <a name="-influxdb--retention_policy--is_default"></a>`is_default`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether this is the database's default policy. Setting it to false on the

##### <a name="-influxdb--retention_policy--admin_username"></a>`admin_username`

Data type: `String[1]`

##### <a name="-influxdb--retention_policy--admin_password"></a>`admin_password`

Data type: `Variant[String[1], Sensitive[String[1]]]`

That user's password. Defaults to `influxdb::admin_password`.

Default value: `$influxdb::admin_password`

##### <a name="-influxdb--retention_policy--port"></a>`port`

Data type: `Stdlib::Port`

The HTTP API port. Defaults to `influxdb::api_port`.

Default value: `$influxdb::api_port`

##### <a name="-influxdb--retention_policy--ssl"></a>`ssl`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether the API uses HTTPS. Defaults to `http.https-enabled` in
`influxdb::configuration`.

Default value: `$influxdb::_ssl`

### <a name="influxdb--user"></a>`influxdb::user`

A non-admin user gets one privilege on one database. An admin user has all
privileges on every database. Puppet checks the password by logging in as
the user, and sets it again if that fails.

#### Examples

##### A read-only user

```puppet
influxdb::user { 'grafana':
  password  => Sensitive('change-me'),
  privilege => 'READ',
  database  => 'telegraf',
}
```

##### A second admin

```puppet
influxdb::user { 'admin2':
  password => Sensitive('change-me-too'),
  is_admin => true,
}
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `influxdb::user` defined type:

* [`ensure`](#-influxdb--user--ensure)
* [`password`](#-influxdb--user--password)
* [`is_admin`](#-influxdb--user--is_admin)
* [`privilege`](#-influxdb--user--privilege)
* [`database`](#-influxdb--user--database)
* [`admin_username`](#-influxdb--user--admin_username)
* [`admin_password`](#-influxdb--user--admin_password)
* [`port`](#-influxdb--user--port)
* [`ssl`](#-influxdb--user--ssl)

##### <a name="-influxdb--user--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

Create or drop the user.

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-influxdb--user--password"></a>`password`

Data type: `Optional[Variant[String[1], Sensitive[String[1]]]]`

The user's password. Required unless `ensure` is `absent`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-influxdb--user--is_admin"></a>`is_admin`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether the user is an admin.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-influxdb--user--privilege"></a>`privilege`

Data type: `Optional[Enum['READ', 'WRITE', 'ALL']]`

What a non-admin user may do in `database`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-influxdb--user--database"></a>`database`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

The database a non-admin user gets `privilege` on.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-influxdb--user--admin_username"></a>`admin_username`

Data type: `String[1]`

The admin user to log in as. Defaults to `influxdb::admin_username`.

Default value: `$influxdb::admin_username`

##### <a name="-influxdb--user--admin_password"></a>`admin_password`

Data type: `Variant[String[1], Sensitive[String[1]]]`

That user's password. Defaults to `influxdb::admin_password`.

Default value: `$influxdb::admin_password`

##### <a name="-influxdb--user--port"></a>`port`

Data type: `Stdlib::Port`

The HTTP API port. Defaults to `influxdb::api_port`.

Default value: `$influxdb::api_port`

##### <a name="-influxdb--user--ssl"></a>`ssl`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether the API uses HTTPS. Defaults to `http.https-enabled` in
`influxdb::configuration`.

Default value: `$influxdb::_ssl`

## Resource types

### <a name="influxdb_auth"></a>`influxdb_auth`

On a server with no users yet, InfluxDB lets the first admin user be
created without logging in, and that's how this type creates it. When
authentication is off it creates the user, or resets its password and
makes it an admin. When authentication is on and other users exist, it
can't log in, so it fails with instructions.

#### Properties

The following properties are available in the `influxdb_auth` type.

##### `ensure`

Valid values: `present`, `absent`

Only `present` does anything; `absent` leaves the user alone.

Default value: `present`

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `influxdb_auth` type.

* [`name`](#-influxdb_auth--name)
* [`provider`](#-influxdb_auth--provider)

##### <a name="-influxdb_auth--name"></a>`name`

namevar

A name for the resource.

##### <a name="-influxdb_auth--provider"></a>`provider`

The specific backend to use for this `influxdb_auth` resource. You will seldom need to specify this --- Puppet will
usually discover the appropriate provider for your platform.

### <a name="influxdb_user"></a>`influxdb_user`

A non-admin user has `privilege` on `database`. An admin user has all
privileges everywhere. InfluxDB doesn't show passwords, so Puppet checks
the password by logging in as the user and sets it again if that fails.

#### Properties

The following properties are available in the `influxdb_user` type.

##### `ensure`

Valid values: `present`, `absent`

The basic property that the resource should be in.

Default value: `present`

##### `password`

The user\'s password.

##### `privilege`

The privilege on `database`: READ, WRITE or ALL. Admins are ALL.

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `influxdb_user` type.

* [`database`](#-influxdb_user--database)
* [`is_admin`](#-influxdb_user--is_admin)
* [`name`](#-influxdb_user--name)
* [`provider`](#-influxdb_user--provider)
* [`username`](#-influxdb_user--username)

##### <a name="-influxdb_user--database"></a>`database`

The database a non-admin user has `privilege` on.

##### <a name="-influxdb_user--is_admin"></a>`is_admin`

Valid values: `true`, `false`, `yes`, `no`

Whether the user is an admin.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-influxdb_user--name"></a>`name`

namevar

A name for the resource.

##### <a name="-influxdb_user--provider"></a>`provider`

The specific backend to use for this `influxdb_user` resource. You will seldom need to specify this --- Puppet will
usually discover the appropriate provider for your platform.

##### <a name="-influxdb_user--username"></a>`username`

The user name. Defaults to the resource name.
